nodes.text: Jacob's House
Faust and Dickens Dean are walking over to Jacob's house. Jacob is waiting for them outside, smoking.
Jacob, Dickens Dean. Dickens Dean, Jacob.
They shake and meet.
Pleasure.
Likewise.
Are you a fellow dreamer with a mad quest of your own?
You might say that.
Excellent. I am a tourist in this fine city, and am friends with your friend John Faust.
Funny, he never said anything about you.
We are new friends.
Jacob's cigarette burns down slowly while he looks the stranger over.
I've known this kid for fifteen years, and he ain't once mentioned you, all I'm saying.
Give my friends their due, Dickens Dean. They are as cool as me, if not moreso.
We are but the company we keep.
Damn straight. So what are you in town for, business?
Several reasons, some personal, some business. I came to your friend John Faust because I have access to resources that will elevate you and your friends to superhero status.
Jesus, sounds like the premise of a bad live-action Japanese television show.
Or rock star, if you prefer. The gal I'm looking for is drawn to larger than life figures. She seems to be preying on them. But she's only after a certain sort of person.
Most guys don't mind being the prey sometimes.
Then you will be perfect for our little trap. I've opened up a club in this town, later on you'll need to get there and make a scene and see if you can draw her out.
John Faust, you weren't kidding when you mentioned life taking a turn towards the surreal.
Just you wait.
No spoilers?
No spoilers.
Wagner's House
Music lingers on the afternoon air. The three approach the steps.
Howdy gentlemen. What brings you here this fine afternoon?
My name is Dickens Dean and I have a proposition for the three of you.
And what would that be?
Dreamstuff. Power. Magick. Resources. You name it, it's yours. Just know that whatever you're working towards brings me closer to my goal.
Sounds positively Faustian, no offense John.
None taken.
Of course, we'll want to know what we're working for.
Good. Progress. Art and beauty. Education. Entertainment.
So you're giving us all the cards, all the chips, hell, the whole game just to do with what we want.
Too good to be true. Of course it is, and it's not without a certain fine print. But I assure you, our goals and ambitions are lined up just right.
But we have to make the choice to help you.
I've got a good feeling about you guys. I can go elsewhere but this feels like the right time and place.
Great. Now you got me curious. So this girl you're after.
She's just a girl.
Aren't they all.
So all you want us to do is help you find her.
Finding her will be easy, keeping her will be hard. She always loses interest so quickly. Keep her eye and force her to settle here for a spell, keep her fascinated.
What's her name?
Aria.
Aria, huh, I'll put the word out.
Thank you. This is an awful lot of exposition to take in in such a short amount of time.
Even the best of narratives are guilty of it.
Give us your number and we'll get back to you.
Faust will be my go-between. He and I are going to your new office. From there, I'll get you the equipment you need to start on your journey.
Our journey? I was under the impression we'll be looking for her here.
Well, yes. You'll see. Actually, do you all want to come along? Might save me time if I just explain as we tour your new digs.

opts.text: Listen to the record a moment longer.

nodes.text: Through the open door, the album on the turn-table plays on to an empty room.
